pr.title: Generated cursor pagination
pr.body: Adds cursor pagination to activity list.

diff: hard_pagination_off_by_one generated cursor uses <= limit and drops has_more sentinel
code_before: items = query |> limit(page_size + 1); has_more = length(items) > page_size
code_after: items = query |> limit(page_size); has_more = length(items) >= page_size

expectedClaims.description: Generated pagination loses the sentinel row and reports has_more incorrectly at page boundaries.

knownNonIssues.description: Not returning total_count is intentional cursor pagination behavior.

traps.kind: intentional behavior documented in PR body
